controlled_time.reason: The public audio input helper and native softcut/DSP analysis require real audio time. The emulator rejects audio capture in controlled-time sessions.

scenes.title: Record audio and paint detected attacks

steps.caption: Select Rhythm Doctor while the sequencer is stopped.
Select Manual tempo, press K3 to apply, then tap Record. Doctor starts listening to the audio input.
Press K3 after enough audio has been recorded. Doctor analyses the recording.
When analysis finishes, Doctor displays the recording window.
Select BD and tap Paint to preview its detected attacks.
Tap Paint again. The attacks are stored in pattern 1.
Tap Play. Channel 1 sends the painted attacks to its MIDI output. Tap Play again to stop.
